This site hosts interactive, serverless course modules powered by [**Quarto Live**](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/) (WebAssembly via Pyodide & webR). All computation runs directly in the student's browser—no backend server required.

## Available Embeddable Lessons

Each lesson page hides the top navigation bar (`navbar: false`) so it embeds cleanly inside a Canvas LMS course page:

1. [**Python Demo: Damped Harmonic Oscillator**](lessons/python-lesson.qmd) — Reactive sliders (`{ojs}` + `{pyodide}`), editable notebook cells, and a self-check exercise with hints & solution.
2. [**R Demo: Central Limit Theorem Explorer**](lessons/r-lesson.qmd) — Interactive `{webr}` simulation using automatic `postMessage` communication for cross-origin Canvas iframes.

---

## Embedding into Canvas

1. Open your Canvas Page and click **Edit**.
2. Switch to the **HTML Editor (`</>`)** in the Rich Content Editor.
3. Paste the `<iframe>` snippet below (replacing `<YOUR-USERNAME>` with your GitHub username or organization):

```html
<iframe
  src="https://<YOUR-USERNAME>.github.io/quarto-live-test/lessons/python-lesson.html"
  width="100%"
  height="750px"
  style="border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px;"
  title="Interactive Python Lesson">
</iframe>
<p style="font-size: 0.9em; margin-top: 0.4em;">
  <a href="https://<YOUR-USERNAME>.github.io/quarto-live-test/lessons/python-lesson.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    Open interactive activity in a new tab ↗
  </a>
</p>
```
